name: Render views
about: The scene's views rendered quickly in Blender by a Claude session on the owner's PC (about 30 s a view on a GPU), each with a mask that protects the products, named after its reference slide; you review each beside its reference. In a project, kept renders go to Renders/; elsewhere they stay with the run, approved. Krea enhancement follows once it is built (R76).
useWhen: The owner wants images of a scene: after Make a scene, from a project (its Scenes/) or from the Make a scene run itself.

input.about: The scene: kept in the project's Scenes/, or given from a Make a scene run (Use in a pipeline). The reference slides or photos to compare with (tick them). Which cameras in the notes (else all CAM_ cameras).

rules.text: The scene the owner kept is never changed: the session renders a copy.
Each render is named after the reference its camera matches, and comes with a mask: black for the products, white for what an AI may change.
Only the owner's review keeps a render: in a project into Renders/, elsewhere approved with the run.

steps.name: Render
steps.outcome: Each camera asked for is rendered quickly with its mask by a session on the owner's PC, named after its reference slide, with a report of the device and the time per view.

steps.name: Review
steps.question: Does each render show the view of its reference? Keep the ones that pass; or pin a comment on an image and send it back.

output.name: Views
output.about: Each view rendered, and the ones kept (in a project, in Renders/).
